title: Astrometric view of companions in the inner dust cavities of protoplanetary discs
question: Do Gaia proper motion anomalies reveal companions in 98 transition disks, how common are they, and can they have carved the dust cavities?

recipe.goal: Compute Gaia proper motion anomaly and significance
recipe.method: PMA = change in proper-motion velocity between Gaia DR2 and DR3, with significance |dmu|/sigma
key_parameters: Most detections at separations ~0.1 to 30 au when combined with RUWE

recipe.method: Stellar masses from Teff and L using Baraffe evolutionary tracks below 1.35 Msun and PARSEC V2.0 above

recipe.goal: Simulate Gaia two-body astrometry per source
recipe.method: Simulate Gaia DR2 and DR3 observations at the real scanning-law epochs and scan angles for a two-body system, 40,000 runs per source
key_parameters: Log-uniform mass ratio 0.0001 to 1 and period 0.01 to 2512 yr
Eccentricity uniform 0 to 1; viewing angles and orbital phases random
assumptions: Astrometric signal dominated by a single companion
Light ratio l = q^3.5, extended from main-sequence stars to Class II YSOs

recipe.goal: Constrain companion mass and separation for detections
recipe.method: Keep simulations whose |dmu|, its significance and RUWE are consistent with the observed values, then take 10th, 50th, 90th percentiles of mass and semi-major axis
assumptions: Broad range around observed RUWE because disks may affect RUWE

recipe.method: For sources without significant PMA, find simulated companions that would have produced a significant PMA or higher RUWE, and treat these as excluded
assumptions: Each system's astrometry dominated by a single companion

recipe.method: Compare the 32% companion fraction with random Gaia stars at 100-200 pc, Sco-Cen and Taurus YSO catalogues and known-binary catalogues; two-sided KS test on stellar mass

recipe.goal: Test whether detected companions can carve the cavities
recipe.method: Bootstrap stellar mass and companion mass and separation from the step 4 results, apply the Rosotti et al. 2025 cavity-size prescription over all inclinations and eccentricities
assumptions: All possible companion inclinations and eccentricities considered

recipe.goal: Test other astrometric noise sources (false positives)
recipe.method: FARGO3D hydro simulations for disk gravity; Monte Carlo simulations of point-like accretion and scattered-light elements
key_parameters: Disk masses 1% to 10% of stellar mass
assumptions: Star at 150 pc in the hydro simulations
